_comment: Numbers behind COLOR_SCRIPT.md. All look offsets are RELATIVE to the house grade (presets/documentary-default/style.json grade.*). Units are FilmCraft Lumetri units, measured 2026-11-09 on a gray ramp (8-bit readout): temperature +10 = R +2 / B -2 levels at mid-gray (+4/-4 at level 240); tint +10 = G -2 at mid-gray; blacks +10 = +4 levels at level 16, +2 at 128, 0 at 255; fade (Lumetri faded_film) +20 = +5 at 16, -6 at 240; contrast +20 = -5 at 48, +5 at 208; saturation in percentage points of the house 104; split_levels = largest channel shift (8-bit levels) the shadow/highlight tint makes at the extreme end of the ramp (tint 0.1 off neutral = 7 levels); motif_sat = Lumetri HSL qualifier saturation boost on the motif hue only (100 = none).

intensity_caps._comment: Largest |offset| a phase may request at each intensity. The plan clamps and logs every clamp. delta_e_budget = mean CIE76 dE of a neutral+skin+primaries reference chart, phase look vs house look; above it the look is nameable ('a filter'). The caps alone allow more than the budget when every one is maxed at once (subtle: 3.6 dE), so a phase has to choose: a strong temperature shift OR strong split-toning, not both. A typical one-idea phase measures about 2 / 3.5 / 5 dE.

phases._shift_comment: A phase shorter than 20 s = two colour shifts closer than 20 s: WARN. Shorter than 12 s: FAIL unless the phase is marked montage:true (owner-approved montage).
phases._blend_comment: Lumetri has no per-clip look keyframing here, so a gradual blend is stepped at the cuts: each shot that starts inside the blend window gets the look interpolated at its midpoint, quantised to 0.25. With 3.5-4.5 s shots a 4 s blend is 1-2 intermediate shots. A hard-cut shift needs a story reason (shock, loss, sudden change).

protection._comment: Multipliers applied to a phase's offsets per shot. chroma = temperature, tint, split_levels, motif. A shot can carry several roles; the smallest multiplier wins.
protection.graphics: Generated plates and house graphics (maps, cards, keyword pops, lower thirds) are NEVER graded: their colour comes from the house palette. Only photographs and footage on V1 are graded.

normalize._comment: Step 2.1: per-image cast correction toward the phase look. Measured on near-neutral pixels only (chroma < neutral_chroma, luma 40-215); skipped when fewer than min_neutral_share of pixels qualify (a sunset or a forest is not a cast). Corrects `strength` of the measured cast, never more than max_temperature / max_tint. Exposure is never auto-corrected: NEIGHBOR_JUMP in QA names the shot and the agent sets grade_adjust.exposure by hand.

pairing._comment: Step 4. Advisory, read by stage 04 (music) and 07b (graphics). Not universal colour meanings: the phase's own intent decides; these only keep grade, pace and sound pulling the same way.

pace.slow_reflective: contrast <= 0, fade or blacks lift allowed

pairing.text: On-screen text stays house off-white; the phase accent may colour a keyword pop / highlight only if it reaches 3:1 contrast against its plate (checked by color_script.py plan).
